abstract: Self-contained authoring guide for hoardodile content plugins: the manifest contract (incl. minAppVersion and i18n for every app language), the definePlugin hook contract (detect/sourceMeta/searchMeta/coverLocal/listFiles/imageHashes/onInstall), the ResourceAPI (incl. the user-consented asset vault with batched downloads and install-time prefetch), the sandboxed iframe client on @hoardodile/sdk-react and @hoardodile/sdk-web, the published-SDK bootstrap, the plugin CLI/workbench toolchain, testing with createResourceAPIFixture, marketplace publishing (registry, zip-only release assets, per-release intro files), and reference implementations to study.
